# Analysis part 1.1
- After forming the iteratively added feature models and predictions, can now visualise and investigate these further by test sites.

```{r}
df_sites <- read_csv(here("data/main/21_analysis_1.1/cleaned_sites.csv"))
df_results <- read_csv(here("data/main/21_analysis_1.1/results_1008_1312.csv"))
```
```{r}
# colour palette
pal = ltc(minou)


p1 <- df_results %>%
    
    # pivot the metrics column long
    pivot_longer(cols = c(r2, rmse), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
    
    # plot
    ggplot(aes(x = n_features, y = value, colour = metric, group = metric)) +
    geom_line() +
    # colour lines
    scale_colour_manual(name = NULL,
                          values = c("r2" = pal[2], 
                                     "rmse" = pal[5])) +
    
    # facet by medoid/test site
    facet_wrap(~test_site, scales = "free_y") + 
    
    # aesthetics
    ggtitle("R-squared and RMSE from consecutively increasing feature counts in RF models") +
    xlab("Number of features in model") +
    theme_bw()
p1
```
